steps.title: Define Project Structure & Metadata
steps.description: Establish the application core configuration, metadata parameters, and project-wide package identifier com.cosmicdefender.app.

steps.title: Configure Build Environment
steps.description: Create the Gradle build file app/build.gradle defining target SDK 34, min SDK 21, and compiler options using Java 8 compatibility.

steps.title: Design Android Manifest
steps.description: Establish application permissions, lock landscape/portrait orientation, declare MainActivity, and apply standard Material Light theme under namespace http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android.

steps.title: Implement Retro Audio Engine
steps.description: Implement a fully native, latency-free, synthesized Audio Synthesis class using AudioTrack for shooting, explosion, and powerup sounds without external assets.

steps.title: Create Entity Models & Logic
steps.description: Build internal entity structures for Player, Lasers, Meteors, Powerups, and dynamic Particle Sparks for advanced explosions.

steps.title: Develop Parallax Starfield & Rendering Engine
steps.description: Implement multi-layered parallax star arrays scrolling at varied relative speeds, drawn dynamically on the canvas.

steps.title: Integrate Physics and Collision Detection
steps.description: Code custom circle/rectangle mathematical collision detection to handle laser-meteor hits, player damage, shield depletion, and powerup collections.

steps.title: Construct High-Performance SurfaceView Game Loop
steps.description: Engineer a stable, low-latency, background thread-driven game rendering loop handling smooth 60fps canvas drawings, frame delays, and touch gesture interactions.

steps.title: Design Custom Game UI Overlays
steps.description: Create activity_main.xml to declare clean screens for high scores, user instructions, credits, the Main Menu overlay, and game status displays.

steps.title: Establish Persistent Score Storage
steps.description: Incorporate SharedPreferences within MainActivity to store, fetch, and display historical player scores, keeping the arcade retro flame alive.

steps.title: Building Cosmic Defender
steps.description: Compile the entire Android package, bundle local resources, verify Java 8 compatibility, build logic layouts, and generate the final debugging package.
